141f8be1308e0f80.description: About the Role The Islamic Development Bank (IsDB) is seeking a Senior Resource Mobilization Specialist to join its team in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. This contract position requires 5-10 years of experience and focuses on providing advanced technical and professional expertise in resource mobilization and partnership development. The role supports the Bank in mobilizing and managing additional resources from sovereign and non-sovereign partners, contributing to the design and implementation of resource mobilization strategies and institutional systems. Key Responsibilities Contribute to the development, periodic review, and implementation of the Bank’s comprehensive resource mobilization strategy and related action plans. Translate resource mobilization priorities into funding propositions and engagement plans for Bank-financed programs, operations, and special initiatives. Develop and assess innovative resource mobilization practices, mechanisms, and products to increase off-balance-sheet, concessional, and grant resources. Engage traditional and non-traditional partners, including official development assistance providers, philanthropists, NGOs, civil society organizations, and the private sector, to identify and advance funding opportunities. Administer and implement resource mobilization arrangements, trust funds, and concessional resources in accordance with approved agreements, policies, and procedures. Operational Planning and Reporting Monitor developments in the financing landscape and analyze opportunities in green, sustainable, social, impact, and results-based financing. Support the design, maintenance, and continuous improvement of systems and tools used to track resource mobilization initiatives, partner engagement, commitments, disbursements, and results. Develop proposed targets, key performance indicators, and analytical reports related to resource mobilization performance for management review. Prepare accurate and timely progress reports, dashboards, briefs, and management updates in compliance with Bank rules and reporting requirements. Identify delivery risks, bottlenecks, and data gaps, recommending practical corrective actions and mitigation measures. Partnership Development and Coordination Develop and maintain productive relationships with donors, development partners, MDBs, IFIs, OIC institutions, and other relevant entities. Coordinate with Regional Hubs, sector and thematic teams, legal, finance, and other functions to originate, structure, and progress resource mobilization and co-financing opportunities. Prepare and coordinate strategic dialogues, partner consultations, missions, workshops, and related follow-up actions with priority partners and donors. Conduct partner mapping, market intelligence, and due diligence analysis to identify new partnership opportunities and diversify the Bank’s funding base. Draft or contribute to concept notes, proposals, partnership frameworks, memoranda of understanding, and funding agreements. Represent the Bank at technical meetings, international events, and development-financing forums as delegated. Knowledge Management and Advisory Support Undertake research and prepare analytical papers, knowledge products, talking points, speeches, presentations, and briefing materials for management on resource mobilization and development financing. Benchmark the Bank’s practices against peer MDBs and IFIs and recommend improvements to policies, processes, tools, and approaches. Capture lessons learned and good practices from resource mobilization initiatives and disseminate them through appropriate institutional knowledge channels. Provide technical guidance and advisory support to colleagues across the Bank on funding instruments, donor requirements, partnership development, and resource mobilization processes. Contribute to internal learning sessions and capacity-building activities that strengthen resource mobilization knowledge and capabilities. Experience Required Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in resource mobilization and partnership development within a financial or development institution context.

1454c3110ddb8aab.description: About the Role TAWANTECH is seeking an AI Quality Assurance Engineer to join their team. This full-time role is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, accuracy, and performance of AI/ML solutions throughout the development lifecycle. The position requires 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Role Overview The AI Quality Assurance Engineer will develop and implement testing strategies for AI models, data pipelines, AI applications, and production deployments. This role ensures that solutions meet business, technical, security, and regulatory requirements, contributing to the overall integrity and performance of AI/ML initiatives. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute comprehensive QA and testing strategies for AI/ML solutions. Validate AI models for accuracy, consistency, robustness, and performance. Design test cases for machine learning models, AI applications, APIs, and data pipelines. Perform data quality, data validation, and data integrity testing. Test AI outputs for accuracy, bias, hallucination, reliability, and consistency where applicable. Conduct regression, integration, functional, performance, and automated testing. Establish quality gates and acceptance criteria for AI model deployment. Monitor model performance and identify model/data drift in production. Collaborate with Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Data Engineers, and Business stakeholders. Automate testing processes and integrate QA activities into CI/CD pipelines. Document defects, test results, risks, and remediation activities. Support model governance, auditability, and compliance requirements. Experience Required Candidates should possess 5-10 years of experience in quality assurance, specifically with a focus on AI/ML solutions. This includes practical experience in developing and implementing testing strategies for complex AI systems. Application Process Further details regarding the application process and salary will be discussed with qualified candidates.

1496540917c898b3.description: About DP World and the Role DP World Jeddah is seeking an experienced Supervisor ITV to join its Operations team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 2-5 years of relevant experience. The ITV Supervisor is responsible for leading, controlling, and optimizing all Internal Terminal Vehicle (ITV) operations during assigned shifts, ensuring the safe, efficient, and continuous movement of containers between the quay, yard, and adjacent terminal areas. Role Overview The role involves managing ITV resources, monitoring fleet availability and utilization, maintaining operational performance, and ensuring compliance with operational procedures and HSSE requirements. The ITV Supervisor works closely with Vessel, Yard, and Planning teams to support operational continuity, minimize delays, and contribute to achieving vessel productivity and overall terminal performance targets. Key Responsibilities Lead, supervise, and coordinate all ITV activities during vessel loading and discharge operations, yard transfers, and Internal Terminal Transfers (ITT). Plan and allocate ITV drivers and equipment based on operational priorities and real-time demands. Monitor ITV cycle times, fleet utilization, equipment availability, and operational productivity, implementing corrective actions as needed. Coordinate closely with Vessel Supervisors, Yard Supervisors, Planning, and other operational teams to maintain workflow continuity. Ensure optimal utilization and balanced deployment of the ITV fleet to support operational efficiency and minimize idle time. Monitor driver attendance, deployment, performance, and discipline while addressing operational resource gaps. Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks, delays, and inefficiencies impacting container movements and terminal performance. Coordinate with Engineering and maintenance teams to ensure timely resolution of equipment breakdowns and operational disruptions. Enforce compliance with HSSE policies, traffic management procedures, speed limits, designated routes, and PPE requirements. Conduct shift briefings and toolbox talks to communicate operational priorities, safety risks, and key operational updates. Monitor driving behavior and ensure adherence to safe operating practices and established procedures. Report and escalate accidents, near misses, unsafe conditions, and equipment-related incidents in accordance with company procedures. Evaluate driver performance and identify training and competency gaps, providing feedback for coaching and development. Prepare accurate shift reports covering fleet utilization, productivity, operational challenges, incidents, and equipment availability. Ensure effective shift handovers by communicating pending activities, operational constraints, and critical information to the incoming supervisor. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in container terminal operations. Proven experience in fleet supervision and resource coordination. Ability to contribute to safe and efficient terminal operations. Application Candidates with experience in container terminal operations, fleet supervision, and resource coordination who are ready to contribute to safe and efficient terminal operations are encouraged to apply.

149dc01792745585.description: About 2P Perfect Presentation Since 2004, 2P Perfect Presentation has been a leader in Saudi Arabia's ICT sector, providing integrated technology solutions to accelerate digital transformation and improve operational efficiency for organizations. The company delivers end-to-end solutions through its specialized business units and market expertise, built on a foundation of innovation and service excellence. The Role 2P Perfect Presentation is seeking an experienced Senior Geographic Information System Specialist to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing, maintaining, and enhancing mission-critical Enterprise GIS infrastructure, spatial geodatabases, and automated geospatial data processing pipelines. The specialist will serve as a core technical custodian of the organization’s ArcGIS Enterprise ecosystem and Enterprise SQL Geodatabases. Key Responsibilities Enterprise GIS Administration & Infrastructure: Administer, monitor, and optimize multi-tier ArcGIS Enterprise environments (Production, Staging, Development), including Portal for ArcGIS, ArcGIS Server, ArcGIS Data Store, and Web Adaptors. Manage system availability, performance, scalability, and operational stability, including High Availability (HA) configurations and disaster recovery processes. Implement automated backup and recovery workflows, manage SSL certificates, user identities, and access rights. Monitor server health, service utilization, logs, and caches, and automate routine maintenance activities. Spatial Database Administration: Administer and optimize Enterprise Geodatabases on Microsoft SQL Server. Manage spatial schema modifications, permissions, versioning, and archiving. Perform geodatabase maintenance routines, monitor database performance, and optimize indexes and spatial queries. Maintain data integrity across environments and manage automated geodatabase backups and FGDB exports. Support recovery and restoration activities. Geoprocessing & Automation: Design and develop custom ArcGIS Pro script tools and Python Toolboxes (.pyt). Build and maintain standalone automation scripts using Python 3, ArcPy, ArcGIS API for Python, and SQL scripting. Develop and maintain automated geoprocessing workflows for tasks such as address assignment, spatial validation, topology detection, data posting, vector tile generation, and Portal item lifecycle management. Develop automated ETL and data syndication pipelines for external partners and schedule automated GIS jobs. Data Quality Assurance & Monitoring: Develop automated rule-based data validation scripts to validate primary key integrity, administrative boundary relationships, sequence logic, spatial topology, and duplicate records. Implement automated daily data screening routines and develop alert mechanisms for data anomalies and processing failures. Support continuous GIS data quality and governance improvement. Innovation & Modern GIS: Explore and pilot emerging capabilities within the Esri ecosystem, evaluating new technologies such as AI Assistants in ArcGIS Pro, Agentic Mapping, and AI-enabled ArcGIS Instant Apps. Identify opportunities to improve automation, GIS operations, and spatial intelligence capabilities. Produce and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, architecture blueprints, data dictionaries, operational procedures, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Required Experience and Skills 5-10 years of experience in a relevant GIS role. Strong hands-on expertise in ArcGIS Enterprise Administration. Proficiency with Microsoft SQL Server spatial databases. Expertise in Python/ArcPy automation and ArcGIS API for Python. Experience with data quality control, vector tile generation, and data syndication. Knowledge of disaster recovery processes for GIS infrastructure. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

1400523acbf8e2f9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة التقنيه والخدمات المتطوره عن أخصائي صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. هذا الدور مخصص لحديثي التخرج، ولا يتطلب خبرة عملية سابقة، حيث يركز على تحديد المخاطر في بيئة العمل وتطوير برامج للوقاية من الأمراض المهنية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتوفر فرصة ممتازة لبدء مسيرة مهنية في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة بيئة العمل لتحديد المخاطر الكيميائية والفيزيائية والإشعاعية والبيولوجية. اقتراح أساليب وإجراءات لتفادي تأثيرات المخاطر على العاملين. تحويل العاملين للفحص الطبي الدوري للتأكد من عدم تأثرهم بأمراض مهنية. قياس وفحص مستويات الإضاءة والتهوية والضجيج في مواقع العمل ومقارنتها بالمستويات المقبولة. التوصية بالإجراءات التصويبية اللازمة لتحسين مستويات الإضاءة والتهوية والضجيج. مراقبة ومتابعة إجراءات التخلص من النفايات الصناعية السائلة والصلبة لضمان عدم تأثيرها على صحة البيئة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في مجال الصحة المهنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالصحة المهنية وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء تنفيذ مختلف أعمال الصحة المهنية. المؤهلات والخبرة لا يشترط توفر خبرة عملية سابقة (0-1 سنة خبرة). هذه الوظيفة مخصصة لحديثي التخرج. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي الصحة والسلامة المهنية ضمن فريق متخصص في الرياض، في بيئة عمل تلتزم بأعلى معايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. تتطلب الوظيفة الالتزام بالدوام الكامل. معلومات إضافية المنطقة: الرياض. نوع العمل: دوام كامل. الراتب: غير معلن.

1430b178f91c73ae.description: تعلن شركة بوخمسين الصناعية عن توفر شاغر وظيفي بمسمى محاسب (Accountant) للانضمام إلى فريق العمل. المهام والمسؤوليات الوظيفية أولًا: المحاسبة العامة والتقارير المالية تسجيل ومراجعة القيود اليومية والتأكد من دقتها واكتمال المستندات الداعمة. متابعة الحسابات العامة وإعداد التسويات المحاسبية الدورية. إعداد ميزان المراجعة والتقارير المالية الشهرية والربع سنوية والسنوية. المشاركة في أعمال الإقفال المحاسبي الشهري والربع سنوي والسنوي. تنظيم وأرشفة المستندات والفواتير والسجلات المحاسبية. ثانيًا: حسابات الموردين والعملاء طلب ومراجعة كشوف حسابات الموردين (SOA) بشكل دوري ومطابقتها مع سجلات الشركة. متابعة الفواتير الناقصة والتأكد من استلام وتسجيل جميع فواتير الموردين. إعداد تسويات حسابات الموردين ومعالجة الفروقات المحاسبية. متابعة أرصدة العملاء والمستحقات المالية والفواتير غير المسددة. إصدار ومراجعة فواتير العملاء والمستخلصات المالية وفق العقود والأعمال المنجزة. متابعة التحصيلات وتحديث تقارير أعمار الديون (Aging Reports). متابعة الدفعات المقدمة والدفعات المستحقة للموردين وربطها بأوامر الشراء والفواتير. ثالثًا: الضرائب والالتزام المالي إعداد ومراجعة إقرارات ضريبة القيمة المضافة (VAT) بشكل ربع سنوي. التأكد من تسجيل جميع فواتير المشتريات والمبيعات ضمن الفترات الضريبية الصحيحة. مراجعة الفترات الضريبية السابقة ومعالجة أي فروقات أو مستندات ناقصة. الالتزام بمتطلبات هيئة الزكاة والضريبة والجمارك (ZATCA) والفوترة الإلكترونية. رابعًا: الحسابات البنكية والمدفوعات إعداد التسويات البنكية ومطابقة الحركات مع السجلات المحاسبية. متابعة التحويلات البنكية المحلية والدولية وتسجيلها محاسبيًا. إعداد جداول المدفوعات المستحقة للموردين ومتابعة تنفيذها بعد الاعتماد. متابعة الشيكات والضمانات البنكية وسندات الأمر والالتزامات المالية. إعداد تقارير التدفقات النقدية والالتزامات والمدفوعات المتوقعة. خامسًا: محاسبة المشاريع والعقود متابعة الحسابات المالية للمشاريع ومطابقتها مع العقود وأوامر الشراء. مراجعة المستخلصات والدفعات المقدمة ونسب الاستقطاع (Retention). متابعة استرداد الضمانات والمبالغ المحتجزة والمستحقات النهائية للمشاريع. إعداد تقارير مالية توضح مستحقات كل مشروع والمدفوعات والتحصيلات. التنسيق مع أقسام المشاريع والمبيعات والمشتريات لضمان صحة البيانات المالية. سادسًا: المتابعة والتنسيق إعداد تقارير دورية للإدارة عن أرصدة الموردين والعملاء والمستحقات. متابعة المعاملات المالية المفتوحة والتأكد من إغلاقها في الوقت المحدد. التنسيق مع الموردين والعملاء والأقسام الداخلية لاستكمال المستندات والتسويات. دعم أعمال التدقيق الداخلي والخارجي وتوفير المستندات المطلوبة. المؤهلات والمتطلبات بكالوريوس في المحاسبة أو المالية. خبرة عملية في المحاسبة، ويفضل في الشركات الصناعية أو المقاولات. معرفة جيدة بالأنظمة المحاسبية والضريبية في المملكة العربية السعودية. إجادة استخدام Microsoft Excel والبرامج المحاسبية. إجادة اللغة الإنجليزية في المراسلات والتعامل مع الموردين. القدرة على إدارة عدة حسابات ومهام في الوقت نفسه. الدقة في العمل والقدرة على المتابعة والالتزام بالمواعيد. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير المالية والتواصل مع الأقسام المختلفة. المسمى الوظيفي: Accountant

1440b9280d65112c.description: About the Role King Abdullah bin Abdelaziz University is seeking a Director of Supply Chain Management. This full-time role involves directing and coordinating tender and contracts, planning, purchasing, and warehousing activities. The primary objective is to limit costs, improve accuracy, and enhance patient service and safety within health affairs operations. Role Purpose and Context The Director of Supply Chain Management will be responsible for managing end-to-end supply chain operations for health affairs. This includes appraising and improving supply chain activities through analysis of spending, supply partnerships, and new possibilities to optimize efficiency and cost-effectiveness. Key Responsibilities Review and update supply chain practices to ensure compliance with new or changing policies, standards, regulations, or laws. Manage the health affairs supply portfolio, ensuring transparency of spending. Generate and implement efficient sourcing and category management strategies. Analyze and calculate procurement costs, suggesting methods to decrease expenditure. Develop negotiation strategies and secure profitable deals with suppliers. Optimize Supply Chain Management (SCM) procedures to achieve maximum efficiency. Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure agreement on terms and processes. Research and anticipate shifts in the negotiating power of suppliers. Perform cost and scenario analysis, along with benchmarking. Estimate risks and apply risk-minimizing techniques. Identify and collaborate with trustworthy vendors and suppliers. Determine the quantity and timing of deliveries. Assist in supporting supplier relationships and reviewing Requests for Quotes. Supervise price negotiations with suppliers. Develop new sourcing methods to facilitate health affairs operations. Analyze market and delivery systems to assess present and future material availability. Resolve vendor or contractor grievances and claims against suppliers. Collaborate with other departments to integrate logistics with business systems or processes, such as patient services, order management, and accounting. Respect patients and their families to promote a patient-centered care culture. Participate in and support quality improvement and patient safety activities. Perform other job-related duties as assigned. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of relevant experience in supply chain management. Work Type This is a full-time position.

149a4c115c3b061d.description: About the Role Systems Arabia is seeking a skilled Jira Administrator to manage, configure, and optimize its Jira environment. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on ensuring efficient project management, streamlined workflows, and effective collaboration across teams. The role requires 2-5 years of experience in Jira administration. Role Overview The Jira Administrator will be responsible for the overall health and functionality of the Jira platform. This includes hands-on experience in Jira administration, workflow customization, user management, and system configuration. A strong understanding of Agile methodologies and Atlassian tools is essential for success in this role. Key Responsibilities Administer and maintain Jira applications to ensure optimal performance, availability, and usability. Configure and manage Jira projects, workflows, issue types, screens, fields, schemes, and permissions. Manage user accounts, groups, roles, access controls, and project-level permissions. Design, customize, and maintain workflows, automation rules, dashboards, and filters based on business requirements. Support Agile teams in configuring and managing Scrum and Kanban boards, backlogs, sprints, and reporting. Troubleshoot Jira-related issues, investigate system errors, and provide technical support to end users. Manage Jira integrations with Confluence, Bitbucket, and other third-party applications. Monitor system performance, perform routine maintenance, and support Jira upgrades and migrations. Establish and maintain Jira administration standards, documentation, and best practices. Collaborate with stakeholders and technical teams to identify opportunities for process improvement and automation. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 3–5 years of hands-on experience in Jira Administration. Strong expertise in Jira configuration, administration, workflow management, and permission schemes. Experience with Jira Software and Jira Service Management (JSM) is an advantage. Good understanding of Agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban. Hands-on experience with Jira automation, dashboards, reporting, and custom configurations. Familiarity with Confluence and other Atlassian products. Knowledge of Jira integrations, REST APIs, and scripting (Groovy, Python, or JavaScript) is an added advantage. Required Skills Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, offering an opportunity to work within a dynamic team focused on optimizing project management and collaboration tools.

14b1c024d8ecb201.description: About the Role Munawla Cargo Company is seeking an HR & Public Relations Specialist to join its team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on managing human resources functions, particularly talent acquisition, and enhancing the company's public image and internal communications within a logistics environment. Role Overview The HR & Public Relations Specialist will contribute to fostering an engaging workplace culture and strengthening corporate communications. The role involves managing recruitment processes, developing employer branding initiatives, and executing internal and external engagement activities. This position requires a professional who can operate effectively in a fast-paced logistics setting and uphold public relations standards. Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end recruitment processes for operational and corporate roles, ensuring a structured onboarding experience. Strengthen employer branding by showcasing Munawla’s workplace culture, company milestones, and team success stories. Plan and execute internal events, employee engagement initiatives, and cultural activities across the Western Region. Build and maintain relationships with external partners, government entities, universities, and career fair organizers to represent Munawla professionally. Draft internal communications, newsletters, and corporate announcements in alignment with corporate governance and brand standards. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Public Relations, Business Administration, or a related field. 2–4 years of proven experience in Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, and Public Relations. Experience in logistics, supply chain, or listed companies is preferred. Exceptional communication, presentation, and content writing skills in both Arabic and English. Strong background in event planning, corporate representation, and stakeholder management. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, and operates within a dynamic logistics environment. The role requires collaboration with various internal departments and external partners to achieve HR and PR objectives. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this role. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

14f8b89a39e56f65.description: About the Role: Digital Communication (SMP) Abdullah A. Al-Barrak & Son Co. is seeking a Digital Communication (SMP) professional to join their team in Dhahran, Eastern region. This full-time role focuses on the installation, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of telecommunications and networking systems within Oil & Gas and petrochemical facilities. The position requires a professional with 5-10 years of experience in the field. Key Responsibilities Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot telecommunications and networking systems in Oil & Gas and petrochemical facilities. Perform technical inspections, diagnostics, and troubleshooting of telecommunications and electronic equipment. Support the operation and maintenance of Cisco networking equipment, routers, and communication systems. Monitor and maintain telecommunications transmission systems, including SDH, STM-16, STM-64, and DWDM technologies. Troubleshoot and maintain XMC-20 (Keymile) Mission-Critical Communication Systems (MCS). Support TETRA communication systems and data networking infrastructure. Identify and resolve technical issues to ensure reliable telecommunications and network performance. Coordinate with technical teams to maintain communication systems and minimize operational disruptions. Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on telecommunications and transmission equipment. Prepare technical reports and document troubleshooting activities, maintenance records, and system performance. Qualifications and Experience Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a Bachelor's degree in a Technical, Trade, or Vocational field specializing in Telecommunications (for local and expat candidates with a degree). A High School Certificate or Vocational School Diploma in Telecommunications is acceptable for expat candidates without a degree. Experience: A minimum of 4 years of experience in the Oil & Gas sector is required for candidates with a degree. For candidates without a degree, a minimum of 11 years of experience in the Oil & Gas sector is required. English Language Proficiency: A minimum IELTS score of or equivalent TOEFL scores (Internet-Based (iBT): 60, Paper-Based (PBT): 498, Computer-Based (CBT): 171) is mandatory. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dhahran, within the Eastern region. The role involves working directly within Oil & Gas and petrochemical facilities, requiring hands-on technical support and coordination with various teams to ensure continuous system performance.

1438fbbf95b04cb0.description: About the Role The Insurance Authority in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, is seeking an Expert of Cybersecurity for a full-time position. This role operates within the vision, mission, and strategic plan of the Insurance Authority. The Expert serves as the principal technical authority for translating evolving threat intelligence into actionable safeguards that fortify enterprise resilience, reporting to the Director of Cybersecurity. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Purpose and Context The Expert of Cybersecurity will analyze complex vulnerabilities, architect and implement advanced controls, and ensure continuous alignment with ISO 27001, NCA ECC, and related regulatory mandates. By orchestrating proactive detection, incident investigation, and secure-by-design advisory, this position aims to reduce risk exposure across cloud and on-premise assets while enabling audit-ready governance. Additionally, the Expert cultivates organizational capability through authoritative reporting and mentorship, elevating security maturity enterprise-wide. Key Responsibilities Analyze vulnerability-scan and threat-intel feeds, correlate findings, and recommend remediation actions to minimize exploitable weaknesses across on-premise and cloud environments. Design and implement targeted technical controls, such as configuration hardening, patch deployment scripting, and compensating safeguards, aligned with the organization's risk appetite. Continually monitor the effectiveness of deployed controls, track closure of identified findings, and escalate systemic gaps to the Director of Cybersecurity for strategic action. Contribute specialist input to risk assessments, control testing, and policy reviews to ensure alignment with ISO 27001, NCA ECC, and other applicable regulatory frameworks. Develop and maintain detailed GRC artifacts, including risk registers, control matrices, and evidence repositories, to enable transparent audit readiness. Advise business units on security requirements for new initiatives, translating policy language into practical control implementations and measurable risk treatments. Participate in 24×7 incident-response rotations, leading technical triage, root-cause analysis, and forensic evidence collection for medium-severity events. Generate post-incident reports documenting impact, lessons learned, and control-enhancement recommendations, feeding insights into continuous-improvement cycles. Review architecture designs, change requests, and vendor proposals, providing expert guidance to ensure solutions meet internal security architecture patterns and data-protection standards. Conduct hands-on penetration testing or red-team exercises for high-risk projects, validating defensive assumptions and advising on remediation priorities. Prepare concise yet comprehensive dashboards and technical reports that communicate risk metrics, control effectiveness, and compliance status to middle management and peer GRC teams. Mentor junior specialists by sharing technical know-how, delivering brown-bag sessions, and contributing to the internal security knowledge base, thereby building collective capability. Perform other job duties as assigned. Experience Required A minimum of 2 to 5 years of experience in cybersecurity or a related field. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within the Insurance Authority. The role involves working closely with the Director of Cybersecurity and collaborating with various business units and GRC teams. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

146c93a6a6c98ddc.description: About the Role alfanar Group is seeking a Financial Controller to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves overseeing financial planning, analysis, and management within a specific division, ensuring alignment with the organization's overall financial strategy. The Financial Controller will provide financial insights, budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation guidance to support strategic decision-making and operational efficiency within the division. Key Responsibilities Develop financial strategies that support business growth and sustainability. Lead budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning processes. Monitor key financial metrics and business performance. Analyze variances and recommend actions to improve margins and cost efficiency. Provide financial insights for pricing, investments, and operational decisions. Build business cases and conduct scenario modeling to guide strategic choices. Identify and implement cost-saving initiatives. Ensure optimal allocation of financial resources across business units. Maintain strong internal controls and ensure regulatory compliance. Coordinate with audit, tax, and legal teams to manage financial risks. Deliver accurate and timely financial reports to leadership. Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for decision-makers. Required Experience and Skills 6-10 years of relevant experience. Ability to recruit, recognize, and cultivate high performers to create a robust second line of management. Capability to address low performance through guidance or necessary action. Commitment to treating subordinates equally without discrimination, with performance as the primary assessment criterion. Ensure the availability of a delegation of authority matrix in line with company policy. Full responsibility for operations as per job description and deliverables, adhering to company guidelines. Ability to anticipate problems and take proactive steps to prevent them. Capacity to make necessary and timely decisions. Deliver required results in a timely manner with specified quality and cost. Demonstrate a tangible positive impact on the area of operation, exceeding business expectations. Ability to transform corporate goals into business plans and execute them. Monitor plan performance, initiate actions to strengthen results, and take corrective measures. Provide periodic work progress reports. Responsible for monitoring and controlling budgets and expenses for optimum cost efficiency. Develop the organizational structure based on current and future requirements. Ensure availability and deployment of job descriptions for all roles. Develop and coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automation opportunities. Proficiency in IT solutions relevant to the job and business, promoting their full utilization. Adherence to quality as a prime competitive advantage for alfanar. Adaptability to new techniques, technologies, management structures, and business models. Ensure a safe, secure, and legal work environment according to standard regulations.

14c1008b811960ed.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اغادير نجد للمقاولات عن سائق شاحنة صغيرة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. سيكون السائق مسؤولاً عن تشغيل الشاحنة بأمان وفعالية وفقاً للمسارات المحددة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل وقيادة الشاحنة الصغيرة والالتزام بالمسارات المحددة وفقاً لخطط العمل المعتمدة. التقيد التام بقواعد المرور وأنظمة الأمن والسلامة، مع الحرص على عدم ارتكاب أي مخالفات نظامية. إجراء فحوصات دورية على الشاحنة للتحقق من سلامتها ومعالجة أي مشكلات بسيطة قد تطرأ عليها. رفع طلبات الصيانة اللازمة عند ملاحظة أي أعطال تتطلب فحصاً من قبل الخبراء المختصين. الالتزام الكامل بأدلة الإجراءات، وأدلة المواصفات والمعايير، وسياسات وقواعد السلامة العامة المتبعة في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في قيادة الشاحنات الصغيرة أو ما يعادلها. رخصة قيادة سارية المفعول تتناسب مع نوع المركبة المطلوبة. القدرة على إجراء الفحوصات الأساسية للمركبة وتحديد المشكلات البسيطة. المهارات المطلوبة الالتزام بقواعد المرور والسلامة. مهارات جيدة في التواصل والتعامل مع التعليمات. الدقة والانتباه للتفاصيل أثناء القيادة والعمل. بيئة العمل يعمل شاغل الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الهفوف بالمنطقة الشرقية، ضمن فريق شركة اغادير نجد للمقاولات. تتطلب الوظيفة الالتزام بالجداول الزمنية والمسارات المحددة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

14f8b449d4bd7d39.description: About Canonical Canonical is a profitable and growing technology company. The sales development organization is regarded as a leading technology sales academy. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Role of Sales Development Representative (Italian Speaker) The Sales Development Representative (SDR) role at Canonical involves collaborating with a regional sales and marketing team. The primary objective is to identify client projects that align with the company's product lines, aiming to expand Canonical's presence and services across various sectors and geographies. This position is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Manage incoming client inquiries via email, phone, and chat. Execute outbound sales and marketing campaigns. Participate in global events and conferences, including booth presence and in-person promotion of marketing and sales opportunities. Collaborate with multiple teams and senior stakeholders to achieve tangible results. Work directly with the marketing team on campaigns. Research information on potential clients. Generate a multi-million dollar pipeline. Identify market prospects and trends. Assist in defining processes and policies for the team. Engage with new and existing clients, organize and attend meetings, and generate an account map to identify new business opportunities. Create, update, maintain, and follow up on leads for global business opportunities. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate for this role is organized, persistent, charismatic, and diligent. A preference is given to individuals with an interest in technology and its business implications. Fluency in Italian is required for this position. In addition to standard benefits, some roles may qualify for additional benefits and rewards, including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or performance. Canonical's compensation philosophy aims to ensure fairness across its global workforce. Additional benefits may apply depending on the work location; further information can be obtained from the Talent Partner.

14371216dcf4742b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الإنشاءات السعودية عن فني صيانة ميكانيكية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دعم عمليات الصيانة والتشغيل والنظافة لمبنى وكالة البلديات بأمانة منطقة الرياض. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الصيانة الميكانيكية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تتبع المخططات الميكانيكية للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية لتحديد إجراءات تشخيص الأعطال. تشخيص أعطال المنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية. تقدير كمية وتكلفة مواد ومستلزمات الصيانة ومتابعة توفيرها. متابعة إجراءات إصلاح الأعطال وفحص الأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية بعد الإصلاح لضمان دقة أدائها وضبطها. متابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية وفقاً للخطط المحددة. إعداد تقارير العمل وتقديمها وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منهجي. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الصيانة الميكانيكية. القدرة على قراءة وتتبع المخططات الميكانيكية. معرفة بإجراءات تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها. بيئة العمل سيعمل الفني ضمن مشروع صيانة وتشغيل ونظافة مبنى وكالة البلديات بأمانة منطقة الرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة الإنشاءات السعودية.

14c631567bbfbb06.description: About the Role of Pastry Chef Al Jeri Investment is seeking a Pastry Chef to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves preparing and presenting a diverse range of pastries, desserts, cakes, and baked goods. Key Responsibilities Prepare a variety of pastries, desserts, cakes, and other baked goods. Ensure the consistent quality and attractive presentation of all products. Develop new recipes and innovative dessert concepts. Maintain strict food safety and hygiene standards in the kitchen. Manage inventory of ingredients and implement strategies to minimize waste. Strong understanding of food safety regulations and hygiene practices. Required Skills Proficiency in various pastry techniques and baking methods. Creativity in developing new recipes and presentation styles. Attention to detail in product quality and aesthetic presentation. Effective inventory management and waste reduction skills. Organize and oversee the review of contractor documentation within the team. Manage interfaces with other disciplines, contractors, vendors, and proponents. Monitor and report on EPCC contractor progress, identify areas of concern, and adjust priorities based on the critical path and overall project schedule. Support the EPCC contractor with commissioning and handover dossier preparations. Monitor and report on contractor/subcontractor progress, issuing periodic progress reports. Organize and coordinate commissioning execution activities. Witness all pre-commissioning and commissioning activities in the assigned area, alongside a team of discipline specialists. Qualifications and Requirements Experience in pre-commissioning and commissioning of petrochemical units and storage facilities. Strong background in Data-IT systems, including Telephone, Wifi, video conferencing, PAGA, and fiber backbone. Background in Security systems, such as ACS, IDAS, and security fencing. Mandatory background in Instrument & Control (EMERSON) systems. Work Environment This is a contract position located in Al Jubail, Eastern region. The role involves working within a team of discipline specialists and managing interfaces with various stakeholders including contractors, vendors, and proponent departments.

1438fe39f0822cab.description: About the Role FNRCO is seeking a Containers Checker to join their team in Dammam, Eastern Region. This full-time position involves inspecting shipping containers to ensure their condition and compliance with operational standards. Key Responsibilities Inspect containers both internally and externally to identify any damage and assess their overall condition. Verify container cleanliness and perform dry sweeping as needed. Identify shipping lines and review Equipment Interchange Receipt (EIR) documents. Accurately record all inspection findings and report any identified damage. Adhere to established container inspection procedures and safety standards. Required Qualifications and Experience Demonstrated experience in shipping container inspection and damage assessment. Experience working within container terminals, ports, shipping yards, or depots. Basic computer skills. Physical fitness suitable for the demands of the role. This role offers a founding opportunity to establish Alan's commercial operations in the Kingdom. The individual will be responsible for shaping the sales approach, identifying target clients, and building relationships with companies interested in providing health experiences for their employees. 14e5519afde7b14b.description: About KBR and the Role KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions (STS) delivers comprehensive solutions across the entire asset lifecycle, including licensed process technologies, advisory services, technical expertise, energy transition solutions, high-end design capabilities, and smart solutions for optimizing assets. KBR is seeking an Electrical Technician I to join their team in Al Jubail, Eastern region, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 5-10 years of experience. Role Overview The Electrical Technician I will be responsible for leading, supervising, and coordinating the daily instrument maintenance activities performed by technicians. 1476e9369be823a9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة النورس المتخصصه لطب الاسنان عن موظف استقبال للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على توفير نقطة اتصال أولى احترافية للزوار والعملاء، وإدارة المكالمات الهاتفية، وتنظيم المواعيد، وضمان سير العمل الإداري بسلاسة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال الزوار والعملاء بترحيب، وتحديد متطلباتهم، وتقديم المعلومات اللازمة لهم. إبلاغ المرجع المعني بوصول المراجعين والعملاء وتوجيههم إليه. استقبال المكالمات الهاتفية والرد على الاستفسارات أو تحويلها إلى المرجع المختص. إجراء الاتصالات الداخلية للحصول على المعلومات المطلوبة. ترتيب وتنسيق مواعيد المقابلات بفعالية. تسجيل أسماء المراجعين والعملاء في السجلات المخصصة لذلك. الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات التنظيمية المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع الزوار والعملاء بلباقة واحترافية. مهارات اتصال ممتازة، شفهية وكتابية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية جيدة. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. الالتزام بالتعليمات والإجراءات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة عمل احترافية في جدة، مكة المكرمة، في شركة النورس المتخصصه لطب الاسنان. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه مسبقًا.

149531bfbedd3884.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اسياف التطوير للمقاولات عن مشغل محطة تحلية مياه للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تشغيل ومراقبة وصيانة أنظمة وآلات التحكم في محطة تحلية المياه لضمان كفاءة الإنتاج وجودة المياه. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل أنظمة التحكم بتحلية المياه، والعمل على إزالة الأملاح والمعادن لإنتاج المياه العذبة. مراقبة عمليات وأنظمة التحكم، وضمان بقاء جودة وحجم إمدادات المياه ضمن الحدود المحددة مسبقاً، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية عند الضرورة. القيام بعمليات فحص روتينية خاصة بأعمال الصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص الأعطال والتلف المحتمل، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الأساسية للأجزاء المعطلة أو المتضررة، وإعداد تقارير بالأعطال لفنيي أو تقنيي الصيانة، واختبار المعدات بعد إصلاحها. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة بتشغيل محطات تحلية المياه أو أنظمة التحكم. القدرة على مراقبة الأنظمة والآلات والتحقق من ظروف التشغيل. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات الصيانة الوقائية والقدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الأساسية. بيئة العمل يتطلب هذا الدور العمل بدوام كامل ضمن محطة تحلية المياه في جدة، مكة المكرمة، ويتضمن مهام تتطلب اليقظة والالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة. معلومات إضافية المنطقة: مكة المكرمة. المدينة: جدة. نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: غير معلن. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

By seamlessly optimizing the seating plan, you will play a direct role in the restaurant's daily performance and atmosphere. Your Profile & Experience Experience: No prior experience is required—your personality, warmth, and natural charm matter most. Familiarity with hospitality reservation systems is a plus. Traits: Elegant, poised, and highly organized. You maintain composure and balance even when the room is full and the pace is fast. Language: English fluency (written and spoken) is mandatory. Additional language skills such as Arabic or French are a genuine advantage. Core Responsibilities Reservation Flow: Manage the waitlist, bookings, walk-ins, and seating arrangements with ease, ensuring every guest feels expected and the room's momentum stays consistent. Proactive Communication: Deliver warm in-person interactions and clear, professional phone etiquette. You anticipate needs naturally, such as taking initial drink orders while guiding guests to their tables. Organization & Profiling: Keep the guest list accurate, actively build detailed guest profiles, and maintain an immaculate reception area at all times.

Perform constructability reviews and provide technical support during the fabrication, installation, and commissioning phases. Engage in vendor technical bid evaluations and provide recommendations for piping equipment and materials. Identify and mitigate technical risks associated with piping and pipeline design throughout the project lifecycle. Contribute to project planning, scheduling, and cost estimation for piping design scope, ensuring timely and budget-conscious delivery. 14dc13268b34b39b.description: Responsibilities: Design standards-aligned OSS/BSS solutions for B2B order management, provisioning, and activation Produce high-level design documents, architecture diagrams, and migration plans aligned with TM Forum standards (640, 641) and ETOM Lead gap analysis and design updates across product catalogue, service inventory, and network element interfaces Define integration points and data flow between order management, OSS, CRM, and southbound systems Manage end-to-end B/OSS project delivery, including scoping, resourcing, and milestones Desired Candidate Profile Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field 12+ years in telecom OSS/BSS, including provisioning, activation, and order management Hands-on experience with B2B order management and service ordering Knowledge of billing, data warehouse, and mediation systems, including CDR/EDR processing Familiarity with ETOM and TM Forum frameworks Strong Java/J2EE and object-oriented design skills Experience with SQL (Oracle, MySQL, or PostgreSQL), XML, and REST/SOAP APIs Experience integrating with provisioning platforms (for example Nokia, Comptel, or Netcracker) Experience with workflow orchestration (for example Camunda) and message streaming (Kafka or IBM MQ) Scripting skills in Python or shell, and GIT version control Strong communication skills with both business and technical stakeholders

14394886cd9eaa75.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة القسي العالمية للمقاولات عن مهندس زراعي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على دراسة خصائص الأراضي والتربة الزراعية، وتصميم شبكات الري والصرف، وتحديد الآلات الزراعية المناسبة، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير المتخصصة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة الخصائص الفيزيائية والكيميائية للتربة الزراعية ومكوناتها. متابعة فحص عينات النبات والتربة ومياه الري وتحليل نتائجها. دراسة واختبار أنواع الأسمدة المناسبة وتقييم استجابة المزروعات لها. دراسة أنظمة الري واختيار الأنسب منها (سطحي، رشاشات، محوري، موضعي). تصميم مخططات وشبكات الري والصرف الزراعي ومتابعة إجراءات التركيب. تقييم كفاءة أنظمة الري وتطويرها. تحديد الآلات الزراعية المناسبة مثل آلات الحراثة والزراعة والرش والحصاد وآلات جرش وخلط الحبوب. إعداد برامج تشغيل وصيانة الآلات الزراعية والتأكد من جاهزيتها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال الزراعي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الزراعية. فهم عميق لخصائص التربة الزراعية وأنظمة الري والصرف. القدرة على تحديد واختيار الآلات الزراعية المناسبة وإدارة صيانتها. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. نوع العمل والموقع هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة جدة، بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. تتيح الفرصة للمهندس الزراعي للمساهمة في مشاريع الشركة ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال مراحل المقابلة.

144496495c33e719.description: About the Role Saudi Railway Company (SAR) is seeking an Information Technology Team Lead to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for implementing IT infrastructure projects and plans, ensuring the provision of advanced technology that aligns with the organization's scale and supports business requirements. The role focuses on delivering tools and solutions to enable business growth and meet SAR's operational needs efficiently and effectively, in accordance with established policies and procedures. Key Responsibilities Manage user and access administration activities on designated systems and applications, adhering to defined policies, standards, and procedures. Oversee the installation and configuration of security systems and applications, including network security appliances and host-based security systems, and assess policy and compliance tools. Benchmark data center activities against international best practices to meet SAR’s specific needs and requirements. Monitor network and security logs, systems, and traffic to ensure the confidentiality, continuity, and availability of IT services. Ensure and monitor daily reporting on server, storage, and backup performance. Implement information security operations and activities to protect information assets while optimizing personnel and equipment use. Monitor, operate, support, and maintain the IT data network infrastructure. Investigate and resolve security violations, providing post-mortem analysis to identify issues and potential solutions. Develop and ensure services in response to various IT risks and threats. Maintain the infrastructure and security systems deployed at SAR. Manage and implement security awareness programs across SAR. Lead disaster recovery projects focused on evaluating technology application. Perform data recovery capacity planning in alignment with current, planned, and new initiatives within the IT Department, with a focus on proactively ensuring an adequate recovery network and IT processing environment. 144d52e84fcf2607.description: About the Role narex is seeking a Warehouse Keeper to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time position involves organizing and managing warehouse operations, maintaining equipment and machinery arrangements, and ensuring efficient receipt, unloading, and organization of shipments according to established procedures. The role offers a salary range of SAR 540–12,000 per month. Key Responsibilities Organize the warehouse and maintain its cleanliness and order. Receive shipments, equipment, devices, and machinery, verifying their condition and quantities upon arrival. Load and unload shipments and equipment, arranging them in designated areas within the warehouse. Arrange equipment, devices, and machinery to facilitate easy access and tracking. Assist with periodic inventory counts of stock and equipment. Adhere to all safety procedures during loading, unloading, and storage operations. Experience with equipment and machinery is preferred. Prior experience using loading and unloading equipment and tools is preferred. Previous experience in equipment and machinery warehouses is preferred. Required Skills and Attributes Ability to handle and organize various types of equipment, devices, and machinery. Capacity to work effectively as part of a team and perform under pressure. Demonstrated commitment, discipline, and responsibility in safeguarding company property. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, focusing on the efficient management and organization of warehouse operations to support the company's needs. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply to contribute to narex's operational efficiency.

14524787c13d919d.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة Maharah Human Resources عن توفر شاغر وظيفي لمهندس معماري بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض. يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد وتطوير التصاميم المعمارية للمشاريع، وتحويل متطلباتها إلى مخططات وتصاميم تجمع بين الجوانب الجمالية والوظيفية، مع ضمان توافقها مع احتياجات المشروع واشتراطات البناء والمواصفات الفنية المعتمدة. يبلغ الراتب الشهري لهذا الدور 8,500 ريال سعودي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتضمن هذا الدور مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان جودة التصاميم المعمارية وتوافقها مع المعايير الفنية ومتطلبات المشاريع. تشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: إعداد وتطوير التصاميم والمخططات المعمارية للمشاريع بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل. مراجعة الرسومات والمخططات المعمارية والتأكد من دقتها ومطابقتها للمواصفات المعتمدة. مراعاة الجوانب الجمالية والوظيفية في التصميم لتحقيق الاستخدام الأمثل للمساحات. التأكد من توافق التصاميم مع اشتراطات البناء والأنظمة والمعايير الهندسية المعمول بها. التنسيق مع المهندسين المدنيين والميكانيكيين والكهربائيين لضمان تكامل المخططات والتصاميم. متابعة تنفيذ الأعمال المعمارية في الموقع والتأكد من مطابقتها للمخططات المعتمدة. مراجعة المواد والتشطيبات المعمارية والتأكد من توافقها مع متطلبات المشروع. متابعة الملاحظات الفنية والعمل على معالجتها بالتنسيق مع الجهات المعنية. إعداد التقارير الفنية ومتابعة التعديلات والتحديثات على المخططات عند الحاجة. المؤهلات والمتطلبات يتطلب هذا الدور مهندسًا معماريًا قادرًا على التعامل مع كافة جوانب التصميم والتنسيق الهندسي. لم يتم تحديد متطلبات الخبرة بشكل صريح، ولكن يُتوقع من المرشح أن يكون لديه الفهم الكافي للمهام المذكورة. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المعماري ضمن فريق في بيئة عمل منظمة، حيث يتطلب الدور التنسيق المستمر مع الفرق الهندسية المختلفة لضمان تنفيذ التصاميم وفقاً للمخططات المعتمدة ومعايير الجودة المطلوبة. تفاصيل العمل أيام العمل: 5 أيام أسبوعياً. الإجازة الأسبوعية: يومان أسبوعياً. ساعات العمل: 8 ساعات يومياً، من الساعة 8:00 صباحاً حتى الساعة 4:00 مساءً. جهة التعاقد: يتم التعاقد مع المرشح من خلال شركة مشغّلة. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المعماريين المهتمين والذين يمتلكون المؤهلات المطلوبة للتقدم لهذا الدور في Maharah Human Resources.

14b0bd281718e620.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الحلول الصناعية المتقدمة عن أخصائي عمليات موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنفيذ ومراقبة إجراءات الموارد البشرية، بما في ذلك إدارة دوام الموظفين والإجازات، وتحديث بيانات الموظفين، والتعامل مع الاستفسارات والشكاوى بمهنية عالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة والنماذج الخاصة بمراقبة دوام موظفي الفروع وإجازاتهم بمختلف أنواعها، وتعديل النماذج عند الحاجة. تطبيق نظام مراقبة الحضور والتأكد من التزام الموظفين بأوقات الدوام الرسمي. تطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الإجازات السنوية والمرضية والطارئة وغيرها من الإجازات المحددة في سياسة العطل والإجازات المعتمدة. تطبيق إجراءات الترقيات والإعارة وانتهاء الخدمة، وتسجيل كافة وقوعات الموظفين وفقاً للأنظمة والإجراءات المعتمدة. التعامل مع شكاوى وملاحظات وطلبات واستفسارات الموظفين بطريقة مهنية، ورفع المشاكل إلى مدير الإدارة عند الحاجة. تحديث المعلومات المتعلقة بالموظفين وتزويدها لفريق خدمات الموظفين، من خلال تسجيل وتوثيق جميع المعلومات المتعلقة بالترقيات والدورات التدريبية والأمور المتعلقة بالرواتب والامتيازات. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة والمتعلقة بعمليات الموارد البشرية، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة والنماذج بفاعلية. مهارات ممتازة في التعامل مع الموظفين وحل المشكلات. المهارات المطلوبة القدرة على تحديث المعلومات بدقة والتعامل مع البيانات الحساسة. مهارات إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. مهارات تواصل قوية ومهنية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، وتتطلب الوظيفة التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق عمليات الموارد البشرية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة الحلول الصناعية المتقدمة.

14d5e34429bec75a.description: About the Role: We are looking for an experienced and passionate Kabab & Steak Chef to join our kitchen team. If you are a master of the grill with a deep understanding of meat cuts, precise temperature control, and authentic marinating techniques, we want to hear from you! You will be responsible for preparing high-quality, flavorful steaks and traditional/fusion kababs, ensuring consistency and excellence with every single order. Key Responsibilities: Expertly grill and prepare a variety of steaks (to exact temperature specifications) and skewers/kababs. Manage meat marination, seasoning, and flavor profiling according to the restaurant's standards. Monitor grill stations efficiently during peak service hours to maintain fast ticket times and high food quality. Strong commitment to cleanliness and food safety standards.

14480f495e337a8f.description: High-level Job Purpose Statement The IT Support Specialist provides Level 1 and Level 2 support for employees using company devices, Microsoft 365 services, approved software, printers, connectivity, and workplace technology. Takes ownership of follow-up and does not allow tickets to remain without an owner, next action, or meaningful update. Works collaboratively with other IT teams and vendors while respecting access, security, change, and approval controls.
